rows.note: Use 針 as the all-purpose everyday word for a sewing, craft, acupuncture, or injection needle.

example.english: This needle is very fine, just right for sewing clothes.
example.traditional: 呢支針好幼，縫衫啱啱好。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 zam1 hou2 jau3 fung4 saam1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

rows.note: Use 指針 for the pointer or indicator on a dial, meter, graph, or similar display.

example.english: The needle on the thermometer is pointing at thirty degrees.
example.traditional: 個溫度計嘅指針指住三十度。
example.jyutping: go3 wan1 dou6 gai3 ge3 zi2 zam1 zi2 zyu6 saam1 sap6 dou6
